Protocol: the module uses the open ProPresenter network API (README and companion/HELP.md: ProPresenter 7.9 and later; the old renewedvision-propresenter module is for older versions) through a ProPresenter object from the npm package renewedvision-propresenter created with host, port and timeout (src/main.ts:290; config fields host and port, default port 1025, src/config.ts:68-79). The transport inside that package was not read. Optionally it opens a MIDI port (default virtual port name "CompanionProPresenterMIDI") to push Companion buttons from ProPresenter (config.ts:91-128). Not run against ProPresenter.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.10.0: options do not support expressions. Text inputs with useVariables resolve $(...) variables.

Option definitions are shared objects (the `options` table in src/utils.ts); several actions reuse the same option id (for example index, cue_index, timeline_operation, group_id_dropdown, audio_item_id, media_item_id) with one isVisible rule that covers every action using it. visibleWhen records that function source as written; it is informational and not evaluated.

Dynamic dropdowns (looks, macros, props, video inputs, timers, stage screens, stage layouts, messages, clear groups, groups) are filled at runtime, see choicesNote on each option. Their ids are mostly UUIDs, but look and group choices use the NAME as id. The static first/only entry in the source (id manually_specify_*) is a placeholder that is always kept as the last choice. The Companion option values for the text fields beside them accept a name, an index or a UUID (tooltips).

Source oddities kept as written: message_id_text has default "TODO: not yet implemented" (src/utils.ts); timer_id_dropdown has the static default "manually_specify_timerid" while the other dropdown placeholders default to "" (the module replaces defaults at runtime, see choicesNote); the clear-layer dropdown labels video_input as "Video_input" in the action and "Video Input" in the Layer feedback.

In the source the runtime choice updates locate several dropdowns by array position (options[0], options[1], options[2], options[4]); reordering options in the source would silently break that. The group dropdown is found by id (src/actions.ts:1310-1313).
